title: Multi-storey locker rooms
content: One recurring dream I have is where I'm back in high school or college, I enter the campus gym's locker room, and it's just this vast, parking garage-sized place. It's wide, with lockers lining the top floor, then on the lower 2-3 floors, there's a fuckton of toilets and showers and clusters of urinals and sinks in their own rooms. Again, it's much like a parking garage. You descend downward like you would there, on a slowly descending loop. There's no exits out of the 3-4-storey locker room besides the top floor's entrance. There's usually some other guys there, chatting away and getting changed. That's all I have to say about that. I'm wondering if anyone here has a similar recurring dream. And yes, I've looked at r/ThatBathroomMazeDream just now.
